purpose: Define the DWH master schema as the common resolvable schema graph/root over module-owned schemas and relations without centralizing ownership of those domain models.

topics.name: DWH Master Schema Root
topics.purpose: Define the DWH master schema as the common resolvable schema graph/root over module-owned schemas and relations without centralizing ownership of those domain models.

semantics.root_rule: DWH exposes one common resolvable schema graph/root for participating module schemas.
semantics.ownership_rule: Each module/schema owner retains ownership of its own domain model and declared relations.
semantics.reference_rule: Master schema composes exact schema/relation refs rather than copied definitions.
semantics.identity_rule: Master schema root identity is distinct from every constituent schema identity.
semantics.extension_rule: Adding a module/domain extends the graph through explicit refs/bindings.
semantics.conflict_rule: Same-identity conflicting schema semantics hard-fail/reconcile explicitly.
semantics.authority_rule: Presence in master schema grants no data access authority.

invariants.rule: DWH resolves and projects schemas/relations but never becomes the semantic owner of module domain models; local/relation bindings require exact declared identities and cannot be inferred from names or proximity.

hard_gates.condition: DWH master schema claims ownership of module models
same identity conflict resolved by file order
schema name used instead of exact ref
master schema presence grants data access
